text:
sarah: Heads-up — new HelixHealth private POC starting next week. They want Redwood Private in their VPC. Need a quick preflight checklist (drivers, k8s, network, keys) and any gating items before we book install window. Can someone list must-haves?

 david: +1. Quick checklist from infra SE side: kernel >= 5.4, no swap, ntp/synced clocks, nvidia-driver >= 515 (525+ preferred), CUDA 11.8 or 12.x recommended, nvidia-container-toolkit installed. K8s 1.24-1.26 supported; kubeadm/managed ok.

mike: Also: container runtime = containerd or Docker (with nvidia-docker2 shim). CRI socket path must be reachable by kubelet. Make sure nodes have writable /var/lib/nvidia.

 david: Commands to validate drivers: `nvidia-smi` (must show GPUs), `modinfo nvidia | grep -i version`, and `cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version`. For CUDA: `nvcc --version` or check `/usr/local/cuda/version.txt`.

 anita: Security notes: we need service account creation instructions and least-privilege RBAC. For KMS: they need network routes to the customer KMS or our proxy depending on setup. If they require HSM, flag now — that adds extra lead time.

 david: Networking: egress to api.redwood.infra:443 (SNI) for image manifests and license checks unless air-gapped. Ports: node->controlplane 10250, kube-api 6443, and we need TCP 443 outbound for our bootstrap (or we provide airgap bundle). If behind proxy, we need proxy creds for image pulls.

 deploy-bot: REMINDER: create a deployment token for bootstrap and mark it single-use. Sales/SE to upload bootstrap token to install runbook.

 sarah: Customer is semi-airgapped — they allow outbound to a small set of endpoints. Mike, can you confirm the exact FQDN list we need to request from their network team?

 mike: I'll dump a minimal list: `api.redwood.infra`, `registry.redwood-internal` (for images), and optionally `crates.redwood.io` for certain telemetry. I'll put a short hostname list in the runbook.

 anita: Also request firewall rule for SSH jump host from our field tech IPs during install window (we'll rotate keys after). Need SOC approval for any long-lived developer access.

 david: GPU driver caveat: some enterprise kernels ship with older nvidia modules; if they use custom kernels we may need DKMS rebuild or kernel headers present. Ask them to install `kernel-headers-$(uname -r)` before driver install.

 sarah: Pricing/Q: Helix asked about using Hosted API keys for initial tests vs full private. We should recommend bootstrap tokens and local-only keys. For production they want private with reserved GPUs — sales to follow up on quoting.

 anita: Security questionnaire item: confirm that the install node OS is patched and conforms to their baseline (CIS/SCAP). We need an approved attestation before production handover.

 david: Airgap plan (if needed): we can supply tarball of images + install bundle. That requires a point-in-time manifest and ~2 hours to stage during install.

 sarah: Next steps: mike to publish the FQDN/port list + driver/CUDA matrix into the customer runbook by EOD. david to prepare short install checklist snippet we can paste into the Helix ticket. Anita to list KMS/HSM gating items. I'll schedule a 60-min pre-install call for Tuesday 10am PT — ok? :calendar:
